svg.title: Torus with a closed 10-turn helical path on its surface
svg.desc: A technical vector diagram of a torus with a light shaded body and a red closed path that wraps once around the major circle and ten times around the tube before returning to its starting point.

g.text: Closed helical path on a torus surface
Path winds 10 times around the tube while completing one major circuit, then closes on itself
u = t, v = 10t on the torus
Red curve: one continuous closed surface path, not an open stripe.
Light dashed mesh lines indicate back-side surface geometry hidden from the viewer in this orthographic projection.
